description: Canonical reference to one installment within a publisher-scoped collection. Installment IDs are collection-scoped, so identity is the tuple (collection_ref, installment_id).

collection_ref.description: Canonical reference to a collection. Collection IDs are scoped to the adagents.json at publisher_domain, so both fields participate in identity.

collection_id.description: Collection ID from the publisher's adagents.json collection catalog.

publisher_domain.description: Domain where the adagents.json declaring this collection is hosted.

collection_ref.title: Collection Reference

installment_id.description: Installment ID within the referenced collection.

title: Installment Reference
